title: Define a Local File Resource
description:
Create a Terraform configuration that uses the local provider to create a file.

Your configuration should:
- Define a resource of type "local_file" named "hello"
- Set the filename to "hello.txt"
- Set the content to "Hello, Terraform!"

Run terraform init, then terraform plan to see what will be created.
solution_explanation: Terraform resources follow the pattern: resource "TYPE" "NAME" { ... }. The local_file resource creates a file on disk. The filename attribute sets the path and content sets what goes in the file. terraform init downloads the required provider, and terraform plan shows what will happen without making changes.
hints_json: The resource type is "local_file" and the name is "hello"
Use filename = "hello.txt" inside the resource block
Use content = "Hello, Terraform!" to set the file content

title: Create Variables and Outputs
description:
Refactor a Terraform configuration to use variables and outputs.

Create three files:
1. **variables.tf** - Define a variable "environment" (string, default "dev") and "app_name" (string, no default)
2. **main.tf** - Use the variables in a local_file resource to create a config file
3. **outputs.tf** - Output the filename and a computed "full_name" combining app_name and environment
solution_explanation: Variables make Terraform configs reusable. Use var.name to reference them. Variables can have types, descriptions, defaults, and validation rules. Outputs expose values after apply — useful for passing data between modules or displaying results.
hints_json: Variables use: variable "name" { type = string, default = "value" }

title: Build a Terraform Module
description:
Create a reusable Terraform module structure.

Build a module that creates a "server config" with the following structure:

1. **main.tf** (root) - Calls the module twice: once for "web" and once for "api"
2. **modules/server-config/main.tf** - The module that creates a local_file with server info
3. **modules/server-config/variables.tf** - Module input variables (server_name, port, environment)
4. **modules/server-config/outputs.tf** - Module outputs (config_path)

The module should create a file named "{server_name}-{environment}.conf" with the server configuration.
solution_explanation: Modules are Terraform's way of creating reusable infrastructure components. A module has its own variables (inputs), resources, and outputs. The root module calls child modules with the module block, passing values via attributes that match the module's variable names. This enables DRY infrastructure code.
hints_json: The module block needs source, plus any required variables as attributes
Module variables are defined in variables.tf inside the module directory
Use var.variable_name inside the module to reference its inputs
